verdict.rationale: Ramp's own marketing directly claims real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries. It also documents syncing auto-coded transactions to the ERP, with a broad list of supported ERPs including NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Xero and Workday. However, only the push direction (Ramp to ERP) is described in any substance; the 'bidirectional' and 'real-time' parts rest on a single one-line claim. Missing for 10: documentation of what data flows back from the ERP into Ramp (e.g. GL accounts, vendors, dimensions), evidence of sync latency or cadence supporting 'real-time', per-ERP depth of the integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that manual journal entries are actually eliminated.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries
